representation: Unit square and basis arrows at the origin, with transformed copies driven by matrix entries a and b.
motion: Sliders a and b move the transformed basis arrows, all four transformed corners, and the highlighted corner.
checkpoints: a = 2 doubles area because det = a
misconceptionTest: The matrix acts on every point consistently; it is not elementwise multiplication, and the transformed grid is not unchanged.
accessibility: Alt text, two keyboard-operable sliders, arrows and labels supplement shape and position.
